name: 2 Minute Football QB Legend
summary: 2 Minute Football QB Legend strips American football down to its most thrilling moments — reading the defense, threading the perfect pass and getting the ball into the end zone. There are no playbooks to memorize and no button combos to learn: every throw starts with a single tap, so you can focus purely on touchdowns. Take command of a live offense against simulated opponents and battle your way from the very first snap to the World Championship. Every game is a short, high-stakes drive where the goal is simple — outscore your opponent before the clock runs out. It's pick-up-and-play football for quick rounds right in your browser, on desktop or mobile.
